answer: Cap the work, not the head count. Each epoch a fixed queue of serial jobs opens in a short dawn window, with inputs from an unpredictable quartz beacon; claim and deliver in time or forfeit the bond. Jobs are serial, so N names cannot do N times the work: claims sharing a payer or device cluster collapse into one ticket. Seniority vests like timber, in slow non-transferable rings a fresh name cannot inherit; weight comes only from finished jobs. The attacker pays N idle bonds, N listeners and N forfeits while the reward pool stays fixed, so identity is a cost with zero marginal return.
